messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: PERF-GPU-MEM-PRESSURE fired for pool=infer-prod-3 region=us-west-2 severity=high - 34% GPU mem alloc failures detected in 60s

sre_jamie: acked - I'm on it, switching pager to me. grabbing logs and nvml output

ashwin: seeing repeated 'CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY' from worker 47f2c, kernel traces show nvml: out_of_memory at 2024-06-15T02:14:09Z

maya: checking running jobs. job runaway-id=chatly-infer-9 (owner: @chatly) is at 98% GPU mem, stuck in loop 

ashwin: nvidia-smi snapshot:
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 535.86.01    Driver Version: 535.86.01    CUDA Version: 12.1   |
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
|  0  A100-SXM4-40G     On        | 00000000:3B:00.0 Off |                    0 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Processes:                                                                  |
|  PID   Type   Process name                  GPU Memory |
| 12345  C      python3                         39820MiB |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+

ashwin: kernel log snippet: [kernel] cdev: nvml alloc failed: failed to allocate 4096MB chunk - OOM

sre_jamie: maya, can you try evicting that job? if it's customer-critical we'll notify. ops_lead: heads up for potential impact to Chatly in us-west-2

maya: evicting job id chatly-infer-9 now -> `kubectl delete pod chatly-infer-9 -n infer-prod`
maya: pod terminated, docker logs show repeated tensor allocation loop prior to crash

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by sre_jamie (1m 12s after firing)

ops_lead: I'm seeing an uptick in 5xx from customer Chatly in the last 2m, approx 12% error rate for their requests routed to us-west-2. Opening a PSAT incident and notifying CSM.

ashwin: after eviction GPU mem freed, but still observing preemption thrash on infer-prod-3 - kv-cache evictions spiking. suspect fragmentation or large pinned tensors.

infra-bot: automated mitigation attempt: scaled pool infer-prod-3 by +2 nodes (instance type g5.12xlarge) to relieve pressure

sre_jamie: added temporary routing rule to divert new Chatly requests to us-east-1 (canary) for the next 10m - config updated.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert auto-escalated to L2 after 5m without stable state

ashwin: handing off to infra due to persistent fragmentation signs - tagging @infra-team. I'll attach heap dumps and model traces to the ticket.

infra-bot: Received handoff - scheduled node-level diagnostics, collecting dmesg + nv_peer_mem stats, ETA 7m

ops_lead: Customer impact summary for ops channel: Chatly experiencing degraded throughput and 12% request errors in us-west-2 for approx 6m. We've rerouted traffic; mitigation in progress. Notifying account team.

maya: after scale and eviction, mem pressure dropping -> current GPU mem used: 8GB / 40GB on the busiest card. No new OOMs in last 90s

sre_jamie: confirming: evicted offending container, scaled +2 nodes, reroute in place. Monitoring token-level latency and error rate.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident update - status=mitigated, active_alerts=2 (decreasing)

ops_lead: I'll open a follow-up Jira (INFRA-6721) for postmortem: investigate model leak vs runtime fragmentation, consider auto-evict threshold tuning and stronger preemptive reroute policy for latencies > 200ms.

ashwin: note to self: attach nvprof and model allocation timeline. propose adding lightweight preflight mem-check for large models.

sre_jamie: handing back to oncall rotation - will leave monitoring handover note. If we see recurrence we'll escalate to SE for model-level patch. :thumbsup:

ops_lead: thanks team. closing this slack thread - will update Jira with timeline and customer comms. :white_check_mark:
